# currency

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/currency>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The currency reference frame in which this monetary amount is expressed. Functional: a [`MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) is in exactly one currency frame. A subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md) from [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Double Entry

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/finance/examples/double-entry.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/finance/examples/double-entry.ttl)

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: money is frame-relative, and the ledger is double-entry
# P11). Every gmeow:MonetaryAmount carries its gmeow:currency as a REFERENCE FRAME
# — "5000" is meaningless; "5000 in the CAD frame" is a coordinate. An invoice is
# recorded as a balanced gmeow:JournalEntry: two gmeow:Postings to gmeow:Ledger-
# Accounts, one DEBIT and one CREDIT of the same amount, so the books balance by
# construction. Debit Accounts-Receivable (an asset), credit Revenue.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/finance/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

ex:amount a gmeow:MonetaryAmount ;
    gmeow:monetaryValue "5000.00"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:currency      gmeow:referenceFrameCAD .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the currency reference frame of a [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) — the frame that makes its magnitude meaningful, the money-specific specialization of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a non-monetary unit (use [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md)) and avoid asserting two currencies on one amount — it is functional, exactly one currency frame per amount; convert into a separate amount instead.

### How to use

- Point the amount at one currency [`ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) and read it through [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) by inheritance; the generated frame-relativity shape ([`gmeow:requiresFrame`](gmeow-requiresFrame.md) [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md)) enforces its presence.

### Examples

- ex:price [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md) ex:usd.
